verdict.rationale: CDP's Agentic Wallet gives an AI agent a standalone wallet to hold, send, and spend USDC, including x402 pay-for-service. The docs list configurable spending limits per session and per transaction, plus a per-payment --max-amount cap. The Coinbase Wallet MCP requires human approval for every write action, and the SDK documents USDC spend permissions on Base. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how a human configures and enforces the session/transaction limits (only a single table row is shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the spend controls work as documented.
